name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The company has defined a Measured & Indicated resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold (454 Moz silver-equivalent) across multiple mineralized zones. AbraSilver is advancing Diablillos toward a construction decision and has applied for inclusion under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI).
